Gold Miners, Silver, Base Metals, Materials, Rails, Telecom, and REITs are all below the trend gate (ineligible) and get no positive lean.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Eligible and rank 1 with a high durability bar (0.69) and very broad trend participation (breadth 0.929) — leadership is real, not a 1-2 name squeeze. The absolute-trend gate (the validated drawdown-control leg) is true, so staying with this leader is supported on a risk-discipline basis, not a return-forecast basis. Crowding (z 1.18) is a sizing caution only, not a fade.
evidence: absolute-trend gate validated risk control (gate_helps true)
theses.dissent: Crowding z 1.18 plus mixed Hurst means the trend is not cleanly persistent — reflexive unwinds can be sharp in energy leadership, and the wide rotation margin (1.393) reflects a large score gap that can close quickly.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Rank 2, eligible, clean trend Hurst, high durability (0.71), broad breadth (0.857), and not crowded (z 0.44). This is a less extended, more durably trending non-energy leader while Oil & Gas is crowded. Supported by the absolute-trend gate as a vol-aware, drawdown-aware holding; the rank gap to Oil & Gas (1.393) means this is not a handoff, just the second-strongest eligible trend.
theses.dissent: The detector's own verdict says relative momentum has no cross-sectional alpha — Big Banks ranking second is not a return signal, and financials can lag the energy-led TSX for long stretches.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO moves below its own 200-day-absolute-trend level before this time next month

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Eligible with the HIGHEST durability bar in the whole set (0.78), clean trend Hurst, breadth 0.75, and not crowded (z -0.47). This is the most trend-durable non-crowded eligible theme on the board, supported by the validated absolute-trend gate as a low-drawdown building block. Its negative small score (-0.05) is irrelevant — rank is a focus lens, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: A negative momentum score and rank 9 mean utilities are a defensive laggard, not leadership — positioning here forfeits the leadership concentration the gate itself is supposed to protect.
